clue.text: Female swans providing plumes for the French

definitions.meaning: a female swan has its own name, distinct from the male cob
the French word plume means a writing instrument, once a quill

explanation.surface: A naturalist notes that lady swans supply feathers to French writers.
explanation.definitionFit: Female swans are so called by their own term, and the French call their writing implements plumes, both meaning the same English word.

clue.text: Business is not shaky

explanation.definitionFit: A firm is a company, and firm also means solid or unwavering.

clue.text: Declined to appear inhuman

definitions.meaning: an old literary sense meaning cruel or fierce

explanation.surface: Someone refused to look cruel.
explanation.definitionFit: Fell is the past of fall (dropped), and an archaic adjective meaning savage or cruel.

clue.text: Could be setting or doing the examination

indicators.note: signals that the word setting could be turned into another arrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: A teacher is either writing an exam paper or sitting it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Could be' rearranges SETTING; 'or' just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Testing is putting someone to an exam, the act of examining.

clue.text: Pinches back headwear for a sportsman

indicators.note: the word for pinches is to be read from end to start

parts.note: pinches means nips
a bowler is a hard round felt hat

explanation.surface: Someone snatches back the hat a sportsman was wearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns NIPS into SPIN; in cricket a spin bowler is one who makes the ball turn.
explanation.definitionFit: A spin bowler is a cricketer specialising in slow, turning deliveries, so a type of sportsman.

clue.text: A person's leisure time

parts.note: the period of life after one stops working, when all time becomes free time

explanation.definitionFit: After giving up work for good, a person's days are wholly leisure, the stage of life following a career.

clue.text: There's some point about displeasure shown when fruit is served

indicators.note: the word for point goes round the word for displeasure

parts.note: a tine is a prong or point, as of a fork
anger is strong displeasure

explanation.surface: Someone sulks pointedly when given fruit at the table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts ANGER inside TINE; 'There's some', 'shown when' and 'is served' are padding.
explanation.definitionFit: A tangerine is a small orange citrus fruit.

clue.text: There are plans for many a supplement

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many
PS, a postscript, is a supplement added to a letter

explanation.surface: A magazine's supplements contain lots of plans.
explanation.definitionFit: Maps are drawn plans of an area.

clue.text: A scrounger incapable of reforming himself?

parts.note: to mend one's ways is to reform
the man himself says that he cannot, written as I can't

explanation.surface: A beggar cannot change his ways.
explanation.walkthrough: 'himself' makes the scrounger speak in the first person: he says he can't mend, with the two words then reversed in order.
explanation.definitionFit: A mendicant is a beggar, someone who lives by asking for money.

clue.text: Given direction, told about bad spirit and dope

parts.note: S for south, a compass direction
an imp is a mischievous spirit
to let on about something is to reveal or tell it

explanation.surface: Someone given orders spoke of an evil spirit and drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dope' is the noun meaning an idiot, not drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: A dope is a fool, a slow-witted person.

clue.text: Wash up for a friend

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for wash is read from bottom to top

parts.note: water laps or washes against a shore

explanation.surface: Doing the dishes for a mate.
explanation.definitionFit: A pal is a mate or chum.

clue.text: Several are in operation in error

indicators.note: the letters sought are sitting inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A number of people are at work and getting it wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across operatioN IN Error.
explanation.definitionFit: Nine is a number above a few, so it counts as several.

clue.text: Stray dog, the object of great devotion

indicators.note: the letters of dog wander out of place into a new order

explanation.surface: A stray mutt is someone's beloved pet.
explanation.definitionFit: A deity is what worshippers devote themselves to.

clue.text: Switch around trainees note it presents a problem

indicators.note: the word for switch is placed round the trainees and the note

parts.note: to switch is to change
L is the learner driver's plate, so two Ls are trainees
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: Rotating the trainees is noted as a difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: A challenge is a demanding task, something that tests one.

clue.text: Cheat over account-change of heart is called for

indicators.note: in a down clue the word for cheat sits above the account

parts.note: to con is to swindle
a version is one person's account of events

explanation.surface: After a swindle over the books, someone must repent.
explanation.definitionFit: A conversion is a turning to new beliefs, a change of heart.

clue.text: Heel and a good man among a number preparing some titbits

indicators.note: the heel, a and good man go inside a number

parts.note: A plus NO, the abbreviation of number
to heel over is to tip or lean
ST, saint, is a good man

explanation.surface: A cad and a saint find themselves in a crowd making canapes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heel' looks like the cad; it is the verb, as a ship heels. 'preparing' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Antipasto is an Italian starter of small savoury bits served before a meal.

clue.text: Place sand strategically and you could have a work of art!

indicators.note: placing letters strategically means arranging them in a new planned order

explanation.surface: A gardener lays sand cleverly and creates a picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A landscape is a painting of countryside scenery.

clue.text: Smooth ore

definitions.meaning: to press creases out of clothes

explanation.definitionFit: To iron is to press clothes flat, and iron is a metal won from ore.

clue.text: Pressing for tick

definitions.meaning: a very short moment, as in 'just a tick'

explanation.definitionFit: Instant means urgent, and an instant is a moment, as is a tick.

clue.text: A bit of fish may be taken by partner after all

parts.note: a fin is part of a fish
an ally is a partner

explanation.surface: Part of a fish may be eaten by one's spouse after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Finally means in the end, at last.

clue.text: Beastly foodstuff containing lead-a sweet sauce

indicators.note: the beastly foodstuff holds the word for lead inside it

parts.note: cud is food chewed again by cattle
a star is the lead in a show

explanation.surface: Animal feed laced with lead turns out to be a dessert topping.
explanation.definitionFit: Custard is a sweet sauce of milk, eggs and sugar.

clue.text: Notice a little page pass out

parts.note: to notice is to see
P is the abbreviation for page

explanation.surface: Someone sees a pageboy faint.
explanation.definitionFit: To seep is to ooze or pass slowly out through something.

clue.text: Sews outer fashion wear for wet weather

indicators.note: to fashion is to shape, so these letters are shaped into a new order

explanation.surface: A tailor makes rain gear by sewing an outer layer.
explanation.definitionFit: A sou'wester is a waterproof hat with a broad back brim, worn in storms.

clue.text: None in a large boat appeal for help in the past

definitions.text: appeal for help in the past

indicators.note: the zero goes inside the boat

parts.note: SS, steamship, is a large boat
O is zero, none

explanation.surface: Nobody on a big ship called for rescue in days gone by.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the past' because the Morse distress signal has been replaced by modern systems.
explanation.definitionFit: SOS was the Morse code distress call used by ships.

clue.text: Bow in a church

parts.note: RC, Roman Catholic, stands for a church

explanation.surface: Someone bows down inside a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A bow is a curved shape, an arc.

clue.text: One's repeatedly running water

indicators.note: the word comes twice in a row

parts.note: one is I, so one's is I's, sounding the same as is

explanation.surface: Someone's always running the taps.
explanation.walkthrough: The ISIS is the name of the Thames as it flows through Oxford.
explanation.definitionFit: The Isis is a stretch of river, the Thames at Oxford.

clue.text: The boards will offer such women employment

definitions.text: The boards will offer such women employment

parts.words: The boards will offer such women employment
parts.note: the boards are the stage, and the women who work on it are performers

explanation.definitionFit: Women who perform plays on stage are employed by the theatre, known as the boards.

clue.text: Not all Irishmen can converse in Gaelic

indicators.note: the language sits inside the word converse

explanation.surface: Some Irishmen cannot speak their native tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not all Irishmen can' is the surface; the letters are the end of convERSE.
explanation.definitionFit: Erse is an old name for Irish or Scottish Gaelic.

clue.text: Arrange spot check

indicators.note: the letters of spot are arranged in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Organise a surprise inspection.
explanation.definitionFit: To check something is to halt it.

clue.text: Certain to make charges about the Right

indicators.note: the word for making charges goes round the right

parts.note: to sue is to bring legal charges
R is short for right

explanation.surface: Someone is bound to bring accusations about right-wingers.
explanation.definitionFit: Sure means certain.

clue.text: The dunderhead getting in as well could cause bother

indicators.note: the head letter goes inside the word for as well

parts.note: too means as well
read as the head of dunder, its first letter D

explanation.surface: An idiot moving in too could make a fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: A to-do is a fuss or commotion.

clue.text: Making real cuts or adjustments in a metropolitan area

indicators.note: adjusting the letters shuffles them into a new order

explanation.surface: Budget cuts are being made in a city district.
explanation.walkthrough: EARLS COURT is a district of west London.
explanation.definitionFit: Earls Court is a district of London, the metropolis.
